1.steps:
1. Send 1500 byte UDP packet with IP Don't Fragment Flag = 1
  2. Check for an ICMP Destination unreachable packet with code = 4
  3. Repeat process 2 more times until until an ICMP Destination unreachable is received, or all 3 packets are sent.
  4. If an ICMP Destination unreachable was sent, verify the the code value is 4 and verify MTU value in the ICMP header.
  5. Reduce the UDP packet size by 1 byte and repeat the process until no ICMP unreachable is sent.
  6. When a packet size is found that does not generate an ICMP unreachable, verify packets can be forwarded using this packet size.
  7. Verify the final MTU size is the same as the MTU size reported in the ICMP unreachable packet.
1.title: Verify router supports Path MTU Discovery over WAN interface
1.result: The box should not allow any of the numbers to be entered in the GUI.
